simple.meaning: קְהִלָּה (qᵉhillâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “an assemblage.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קְהִלָּה (H6952) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 33:4, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְהִלָּה (H6952) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קְהִלָּה (H6952) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קְהִלָּה (qᵉhillâh) / H6952 is traced through Deuteronomy 33:4, Nehemiah 5:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
